name: Break After Focus
title: Reset after focused work.
benefit: Restored focus for your next block of work.
subtitle: Focus Recovery
rationale: Genuine disengagement, rather than a screen-based break, is what allows attention to recover for the next block.

evidence.summary: Deliberate breaks reduce fatigue and improve vigor during sustained work.

indications: Focus blocks end and the next one starts without a break.
Output quality decays across consecutive deep-work sessions.
Breaks default to feeds instead of genuine disengagement.
